intellectual_tradition: 公羊学派/汉代儒学/天人感应思想
famous_quote: 道之大原出于天，天不变道亦不变

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 天之道与人之道一致而相通，天是至高无上的本体与价值根源。人之形体、情感、道德皆本于天，人以类合方式与天对应相通。此法是董仲舒宇宙论的核心，将儒家伦理提升至形而上学本体高度。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The Way of Heaven and the Way of Humanity are consistent and interconnected; Heaven is the supreme ontological and axiological source. Human physical form, emotions, and morality all derive from Heaven, with humanity resonating through correspondence of categories. This method is the core of Dong Zhongshu's cosmology, elevating Confucian ethics to metaphysical ontology.
process: 确立天的本体地位——至高无上的人格神与万物之本
理解天道与人道的同构关系——天之数与人之数相副
通过观察天象四时把握天道运行规律
以人道效法天道，实现天人合一的价值体系
modern_applications: 生态伦理与可持续发展

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·三代改制质文》《汉书·董仲舒传》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 大一统是天经地义的秩序原则，一切归于天，天子受命于天，天下受命于天子，形成自上而下的等级统属关系。思想统一是政治统一的前提，罢黜百家独尊儒术是大一统的制度保障。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Great Unity (Da-Yi-Tong) is the cosmic principle of order—everything归属于天. The Son of Heaven receives mandate from Heaven, the world receives mandate from the Son of Heaven, forming a hierarchical chain of command. Ideological unity is the prerequisite of political unity; abolishing百家独尊儒术 is the institutional guarantee of Great Unity.
process: 确认大一统为天经地义的秩序原则
建立天子受命于天、诸侯受命于天子的垂直统属链条
统一思想来源，确立单一权威的价值标准
通过制度设计保障意识形态统一
modern_applications: 企业文化与价值观建设

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·天产人》《举贤良对策》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 天道任德不任刑，王者承天意以从事，故务德教而省刑罚。以德为主、以刑为辅，教化为本、刑罚为末，是天道运行的政治映射。此法反对秦代纯任刑罚的治国路线，主张以仁政德治稳固政权。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Heaven's way operates through virtue not punishment. The sovereign receives Heaven's mandate and thus prioritizes moral education over刑罚. Virtue as primary, punishment as secondary;教化 as foundation, 刑罚 as last resort—the political reflection of cosmic operation. This method opposes the Qin dynasty's purely penal governance and advocates ruling through benevolent virtue to consolidate power.
process: 确认天道任德不任刑的根本原则
以仁政德治替代严刑峻法的治国路线
通过教化培养民众道德自觉
刑罚作为德教的辅助手段谨慎使用

thinking_modes.name_en: Three Guides Five Constants Method (San-Gang Wu-Chang)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 王道之三纲可求于天。君为臣纲、父为子纲、夫为妻纲是三纲；仁义礼智信是五常。三纲确立等级服从关系，五常提供普遍道德规范。二者以阴阳五行论证，阳贵阴贱、阳尊阴卑，使封建伦理获得宇宙论支撑。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The Three Guides of kinglyWay can be sought in Heaven. Ruler guides subject, father guides son, husband guides wife—these are the Three Guides. Benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom, and trustworthiness are the Five Constants. The Three Guides establish hierarchical obedience relations; the Five Constants provide universal moral norms. Both are论证ed through Yin-Yang Five Elements—yang尊贵阴卑——giving feudal ethics cosmic-theoretical support.
process: 确立阴阳为宇宙根本法则——阳贵阴贱
将三纲关系对应阴阳尊卑——君臣、父子、夫妇
以五常作为普遍道德规范——仁义礼智信
通过伦理自然化使等级秩序获得合法性

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·必仁且智》《汉书·董仲舒传》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 天通过灾异祥瑞对人事进行谴告。灾异（火灾、水灾、日蚀、彗星等）是天对失道之君的警告，祥瑞是天子行善政的嘉奖。此法是董仲舒制约君权的独特机制——以天象警示代替人间反抗，在承认君权神圣的同时保留批判空间。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Heaven admonishes human affairs through disasters and auspicious omens. Disasters (fires, floods, solar eclipses, comets etc.) are Heaven's warnings to rulers who have lost the Way; auspicious omens reward virtuous governance. This method is Dong Zhongshu's unique mechanism for constraining imperial power—replacing earthly rebellion with celestial warnings, preserving critical space while acknowledging divine right.
process: 观察天象异变（灾异或祥瑞）
以《春秋》灾异记录为解释依据
将天象与君主行为建立因果关系
君主通过修德改过回应天谴

thinking_modes.name_en: Spring and Autumn Judicial Method (Substantive Interpretation)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 本其事而原其志。以《春秋》经义作为裁判依据，透过法律文本探求行为人的主观动机与道德意图。此法是实质正义优于形式正义的司法方法论，开创了中国传统法律儒家化的先河。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Examine the facts and trace the original intent. Using Spring and Autumn Classic principles as adjudication basis, piercing through legal texts to discover the actor's subjective motivation and moral intent. This method prioritizes substantive justice over formal justice, inaugurating the Confucianization of Chinese traditional law.
process: 查明案件事实经过
追溯行为人的主观动机与原心
以《春秋》经义判断是非曲直
综合事实与动机作出裁判
modern_applications: 司法裁判中的动机考量
道德与法律冲突的协调

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·五行阴阳》《春秋繁露·阴阳义》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 阴阳二气充盈天地，五行（木火土金水）相生相克，共同构成宇宙运行的基本框架。董仲舒是最早系统提出五行相生说的思想家，以阴阳五行解释四季变化、政治秩序、人体结构、道德属性等一切现象，构建了庞大而精密的宇宙分类系统。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Yin-Yang qi fills heaven and earth; the Five Elements (wood, fire, earth, metal, water) generate and overcome each other, together constituting the fundamental framework of cosmic operation. Dong Zhongshu was the first thinker to systematically propose the Five Elements generation cycle, using Yin-Yang Five Elements to explain seasonal changes, political order, human physiology, moral attributes, and all phenomena—constructing an enormously intricate cosmological classification system.
process: 以阴阳二气解释宇宙根本动力
将五行相生确立为宇宙循环基本规律
以阴阳配属政治伦理——阳德阴刑
通过类比推理将宇宙秩序映射到人类社会
modern_applications: 系统思维与分类方法论

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 历史以三统（黑统、白统、赤统）为一周期循环更替。每次改制应顺天意，根据当统之色改变服色、官名、礼制，但根本之道不变。此法是董仲舒的历史哲学框架，既承认变革的必要性，又坚守永恒的天道原则。
thinking_modes.definition_en: History cycles through Three Dynastic Unities (Black, White, Red Unities) as one period. Each institutional reform must follow Heaven's mandate, changing dress color, official titles, and ritual systems according to the current unity, but the fundamental Way remains unchanging. This is Dong Zhongshu's historical philosophy framework—acknowledging the necessity of change while holding fast to eternal heavenly principles.
process: 识别当前所居之三统序列
确认当统对应的服色、制度、礼仪规范
在不违背根本天道的前提下进行制度调整
理解变革与守道的辩证统一
modern_applications: 制度创新与传统文化继承
历史周期律的认知框架

thinking_modes.name_en: Three Grades of Nature Education Method
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·性情》《春秋繁露·本性》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人性分三品：圣人不教而善（上智）、中民待教而善（中人）、斗筲不教而恶（下愚）。以此为依据设计分层教化体系，因材施教。此法是董仲舒人性论与教育政治学的结合，为儒家等级教化提供了理论基础。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Human nature has three grades: sages are good without teaching (highest), commoners become good through teaching (middle), base people are evil without teaching (lowest). Design tiered education system accordingly. This method combines Dong Zhongshu's theory of human nature with educational political theory, providing theoretical foundation for Confucian hierarchical education.
process: 识别人性等级——区分圣人、中民、斗筲三品
设计分层方案——针对不同等级制定教化策略
实施礼法教化——以礼仪法度为教化工具
评估教化效果——通过考绩绌陟验证成果

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·五行阴阳》《春秋繁露·阴阳义》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳五行为通用类比框架，将自然现象、社会关系、政治制度、道德规范纳入同一解释系统。同类相动、以类合以数偶。此法是董仲舒方法论的核心——通过宇宙论分类实现跨域映射与规范推导。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Use yin-yang and five elements as universal analogical framework, incorporating natural phenomena, social relations, political institutions, and moral norms into single explanatory system. Same category moves same category. This is the methodological core of Dong Zhongshu—achieving cross-domain mapping and normative derivation through cosmological classification.
process: 建立阴阳五行分类体系
识别同类关系
进行类比映射
得出规范性结论

steps_zh: Step 1: 天人相应——确认天的本体地位，建立天道与人道的同构映射
Step 2: 大一统序——以上天命下统属的链条建立政治统一秩序
Step 3: 阴阳定位——以阴阳尊卑论证三纲五常的宇宙论基础
Step 4: 德主刑辅——在天道任德原则下确立教化优先的治国方略
Step 5: 灾异预警——通过天象异变监控政治运行并纠正偏差
Step 6: 春秋决狱——以经义探求动机，实现实质正义的司法方法
Step 7: 三统循环——在历史周期中理解变革与守道的辩证关系
Step 8: 性三品教化——以人性三品论设计分层教化体系
Step 9: 阴阳类比——以阴阳五行统摄自然社会政治道德的跨域映射
steps_en: Step 1: Tian-Ren Correspondence — Confirm Heaven's ontological status, establish the isomorphic mapping between Heavenly Way and Human Way
Step 2: Great Unity Order — Build political unified order through the heavenly mandate to subordination chain
Step 3: Yin-Yang Positioning — Demonstrate the cosmological foundation of Three Guides Five Constants through yin-yang hierarchy
Step 4: Virtue-Primary Governance — Establish教化-first statecraft under the principle of Heaven's virtue
Step 5: Disaster Warning — Monitor political operation and correct deviations through celestial anomalies
Step 6: Spring and Autumn Judgement — Achieve substantive justice in judiciary by probing intent through classic principles
Step 7: Three Dynastic Cycles — Understand the dialectic of change and constancy within historical cycles
Step 8: Three Grades Education — Design tiered education system based on three grades of human nature
Step 9: Yin-Yang Analogy — Use yin-yang five elements for cross-domain mapping across nature, society, politics, morality
unique_contributions_zh: 首创天人感应系统理论——将儒家伦理提升至宇宙本体高度，建立完整的形上学框架
创建三纲五常伦理总纲——以阴阳五行论证等级秩序的宇宙论基础，使儒家伦理获得神圣性
设计大一统意识形态制度——提出罢黜百家独尊儒术，开创中国正统思想文化模式
构建灾异谴告约束机制——以天象警示制约君权，在神化皇权的同时保留批判空间
开创春秋决狱经义司法——以实质解释方法超越形式法律，奠定中华法系伦理化传统
unique_contributions_en: Pioneered systematic Tian-Ren resonance theory—elevated Confucian ethics to cosmic ontology, establishing complete metaphysical framework
Created the Three Guides Five Constants ethical canon—论证ed hierarchical order's cosmological basis through Yin-Yang Five Elements, granting Confucian ethics sacred legitimacy
Designed Great Unity ideological system—proposed abolishing百家独尊儒术, inaugurating orthodox thought-cultural model of China
Constructed disaster admonition constraint mechanism—used celestial warnings to check imperial power, preserving critical space while deifying monarchy
Inaugurated Spring and Autumn judicial interpretation—prioritized substantive over formal justice, establishing the ethicized tradition of Chinese legal system
comparative_position_zh: 董仲舒是连接先秦儒学与宋明理学的关键枢纽。他对孔孟的继承体现在以仁义为核心价值，对荀子的继承体现在隆礼重法思路，对阴阳家的吸收体现在宇宙论框架。与孔子相比，董仲舒的重大突破在于为儒家伦理提供了系统的宇宙论支撑；与孟子相比，董仲舒的独特贡献在于构建了政治神学体系；与张载相比，董仲舒更注重意识形态制度建设而非纯粹本体论建构。
comparative_position_en: Dong Zhongshu is the critical pivot connecting Pre-Qin Confucianism to Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism. His inheritance of Confucius and Mencius lies in centering Ren-Yi as core values; his inheritance of Xunzi lies in the ritual-law emphasis approach; his absorption of Yin-Yang school lies in the cosmological framework. Compared to Confucius, Dong's major breakthrough lies in providing systematic cosmological support for Confucian ethics; compared to Mencius, Dong's unique contribution lies in constructing a political theology system; compared to Zhang Zai, Dong focused more on ideological institutional construction than pure ontology.
